records.name: Murata GRM188R72A104KA35D 100nF 100V 0603 capacitor
records.description: Concrete active 100 nF X7R 0603 ceramic capacitor with reviewed low-voltage switching-support evidence.

capacitor_evidence.review_note: Murata part-specific rated and characteristic data prove the 100 nF, 100 V, X7R, 0603 construction. At the reviewed controller-support ceiling of 5.5 V, the published DC-bias curve retains well over 90 percent of nominal capacitance; the frequency plot proves low impedance and ESR through the sub-megahertz switching range. Circuit synthesis enforces the 10 percent maximum voltage-use ratio and local SMD placement.

notes: Fabrication use is bounded to at most 10 percent of the 100 V rating by typed capacitor evidence.

records.name: Murata GRM188R71E474KA12D 470nF 25V 0603 capacitor
records.description: Concrete active 470 nF X7R 0603 ceramic capacitor for bootstrap and local bypass service.

capacitor_evidence.review_note: Murata part-specific rated and characteristic data prove the 470 nF, 25 V, X7R, 0603 construction and low-impedance behavior. The reviewed bootstrap application is bounded to 5.5 V across the capacitor, below 25 percent of rating, with deterministic local SMD placement.

records.name: Murata GRM188Z71C475KE21D 4.7uF 16V 0603 capacitor
records.description: Concrete active 4.7 uF X7R 0603 ceramic capacitor for low-voltage controller bypass service.

capacitor_evidence.review_note: Murata part-specific data prove the 4.7 uF, 16 V, X7R, 0603 construction and specify the temperature envelope with 8 V DC applied. The reviewed controller-bypass use is limited to 5.5 V, leaving more than two-to-one effective-capacitance margin over a 2.2 uF requirement, and requires local SMD placement.
